names_no_landmarks: Bands are reported by height fraction only. No band is called a head, a waist or a shoulder: a stylised character has no landmark a program can find, and naming one is how a waist was once reported as a head.

three_quarter.excluded_as_reference: graded AMBIGUOUS for orientation; the stylised pose makes the asymmetric marker unreadable, and an ambiguous reference invites modelling to an unstateable angle
